criteria.name: json_and_sources
criteria.description: Returns JSON and cites ONI, SOI, CPC anchor, precipitation, embedding, population, and event files.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for valid JSON using only ONI/SOI.

criteria.name: core_window_reconstruction
criteria.description: Reports SON 2023-DJF 2024, 2023-10 to 2024-01, peak NDJ 2023 at 2.06 C, mean 1.95 C, min 1.83 C, and spread 0.23 C.

criteria.name: coupling_diagnosis
criteria.description: Pairs SOI values -0.8, -1.3, -0.4, 0.8 with the core months, computes mean -0.43, 3/4 negative months, and coupling index 0.83.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for correct SOI extraction but missing coupling interpretation.

criteria.name: event_evolution
criteria.description: Identifies the >=0.5 C warm episode length, ramp rate from the first in-window warm season to peak, and post-peak decay to MAM 2024 of 1.24 C.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for either ramp or decay.

criteria.name: hydro_exposure_context
criteria.description: Uses ERA5/GPM/CHIRPS, embedding, and WorldPop values with their context windows as lagged teleconnection stress context without over-attributing local damage.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for precipitation context alone.

criteria.name: scenario_and_limits
criteria.description: Computes the core-extension sensitivity test, identifies it as not a forecast, and keeps conclusions lag-aware and spatially heterogeneous.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point for qualitative scenario only.
